newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Insurer Royale Belge shares up 2.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Insurer Royale Belge shares up 2.0 pct.

text.p: Shares in insurer Royale Belge bucked the general downtrend on the Brussels bourse on Friday, climbing two percent as investors took heart from a good set of 1996 annual results released late on Thursday.
The share was up 170 francs at 8,800 at 1115 GMT. It was the only gainer among shares in the Bel-20 index which was down 1.29 percent.
Royale Belge reported a jump in annual profits to 11.3 billion francs in 1996. It said it would pay a bonus dividend and that it estimated its share was worth nearer 10,000 francs.
